business_scope.primary_industry_name: Computerized Embroidery and Ultrasonic Seaming of Custom Plush Dolls

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English-derived company and trust jurisprudence, with customary law confined to land and family matters)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), in force for Samoa since 13 December 2020
World Trade Organization (WTO) Membership, effective 10 May 2012
Treaty of Friendship between Samoa and the United States of America (1962), providing mutual commerce and navigation privileges

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended, including the Amendment Acts of 2009 and 2011); International Companies (Money Laundering Prevention) Act 2011; Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007; Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2007; and the AML/CFT Guidelines issued by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU). The UBO register is maintained by the licensed International Service Provider and is confidential, not a public register.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport (photo page) for each ultimate beneficial owner and designated director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin of the individual
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or Consular Legalization if the country of origin is not an Apostille Convention member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Banker's reference / proof of source-of-funds letter
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank in the UBO's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (or equivalent extract) for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly certified Memorandum and Articles (or constitutive deed) of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Original incorporating authority or notary in the jurisdiction of incorporation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory CDD identifying each natural person owning or controlling 25% or more of the International Company; mandatory screening against the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, the OFAC SDN List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the Samoa FIU domestic dissemination list; enhanced due diligence (EDD) is statutorily required for PEPs, their family members and close associates, including senior foreign officials in the plush toy OEM supply chain; negative media and adverse-information checks must be completed before acceptance of incorporation instructions.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Companies Registry (Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour), online name clearance and reservation system, operative exclusively through licensed International Service Providers
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be in English/Roman characters; non-Roman scripts are not registered; any Samoan-language word must be in romanized form with an English translation; the name must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' and must not be identical or confusingly similar to a name on the Registry, a protected Samoan or foreign government name, or a mark protected under the Samoan Trade Marks Act.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected name may be resubmitted with a different distinguishing element or objected to in writing. The licensed International Service Provider files a written appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of the rejection notice, stating grounds of non-identity and non-similarity and attaching the clearance printout; the Registrar must issue a determination within 21 days, and a further fresh-reservation application may be made upon expiry of any 30-day reservation window. Reservation renewals are permissible for successive 30-day periods before formal incorporation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office is not permissible as the sole registered office. The International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Apia at the premises of a licensed International Service Provider, where statutory records, seal, registers of members, directors and UBOs are physically kept. Shared accommodation within the registered agent's office is acceptable for a non-financial plush toy OEM; no separate leased plant is required at the pre-incorporation stage, but the company must be able to evidence business activity (contracts, invoices, bank transactions) separate from the shell standard.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; quantified at approximately 5% annual probability for a low-risk ISIC 3240 manufacturing entity. Unannounced inspections are principally directed at licensed International Service Providers rather than the underlying International Company. Probability may rise to 20% if high-risk counterparties, adverse media or inconsistent substance indicators emerge.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies Act 1987 Fee Schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed International Service Provider compliance officer

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille or consular legalization of UBO/shareholder document bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public; Competent Authority (Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, Samoa) or foreign consulate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal due diligence opinion and incorporation document drafting (external counsel)
Courier disbursement for apostilled originals and registered agent filing delivery

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2016; key sections: s.5 (incorporation procedure), s.7 (registered office and registered agent), s.10 (effect of registration), and s.24 (memorandum of association); supplemented by the International Companies Regulations 1998.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), P.O. Box 862, Apia, Samoa; administrative services coordinated with the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 (Application for Registration of an International Company) accompanied by the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, filed pursuant to s.10 of the International Companies Act 1987.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the Company may issue a single ordinary share at nominal par value (commonly USD 1). No escrow, capital deposit, or bank reference is required at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company's incorporation under the International Companies Act 1987 is ratified and the filed Memorandum and Articles of Association are adopted in full. RESOLVED, that [SUBSCRIBER] is allotted [NUMBER] ordinary shares at par, credited as fully paid, and entered in the Register of Members. RESOLVED, that the registered office is established at [ADDRESS], Apia, Samoa, and the registered agent is authorised to act. RESOLVED, that [DIRECTOR] be appointed Sole Director and [SECRETARY] Corporate Secretary. RESOLVED, that [PRESIDENT] be appointed President and [TREASURER] Treasurer, with authority to open bank accounts, sign contracts, and execute all formation instruments. RESOLVED, that a common seal is adopted and any director, acting with the Secretary, may attest documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IC-NR via the MCIL counter or through a licensed registered agent. The proposed name of the International Company must terminate with 'Limited' or 'Ltd.', must not be identical or misleadingly similar to any name in the Companies Register, and must not contain restricted words such as 'Bank', 'Trust', or 'Insurance' without prior sectoral consent. Two alternative names may be proposed in the same application.
required_dossiers: Notarized consent letter for restricted words (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, the applicant may file a fresh Form IC-NR with alternative names within 3 business days; there is no statutory appeal against an administrative refusal and the matter is cured by refiling.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent approved by the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the standard IC form, including the authorised share capital, the objects clause covering manufacturing, computerised embroidery, ultrasonic seaming, and wholesale trade of plush dolls, and the director and officer appointment machinery. The subscriber must execute the document before a notary or the registered agent who endorses a certificate of compliance.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries a clause as non-compliant, the registered agent may lodge a corrective amendment and re-execution within 5 business days; no additional state fee applies for a first resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of Form IC-1 and Statutory Declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL (physical counter or SIFA-approved e-portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the completed Form IC-1, the executed M&A in duplicate, the consent of the registered agent, and a statutory declaration of compliance signed by the subscriber, together with the state filing fee of USD 150. Upon acceptance, the Registrar stamps the application and opens the statutory record.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association (2 copies)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the applicant has 14 days to file a corrective statutory declaration (Form IC-1A) or supplementary information; failure to cure within the period results in automatic rejection, after which a fresh application with a new fee may be lodged.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation, assigns a unique IC registration number, and enters the Company in the International Companies Register. The Company acquires legal personality from the date of the certificate; a certified copy is transmitted to the registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a typographical error, file Form IC-REPL with a statutory declaration and obtain a reissued certificate within 2 business days at no extra state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Corporate Secretary (internal governance; no registry filing required)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The sole director or the board holds the first meeting (or passes a written unanimous resolution) to adopt the first board resolution, allot shares, appoint officers, approve the registered office, and open the statutory registers (register of members, directors, charges, and minutes). If a quorum is not present in Samoa, a telephonic or videoconference meeting is valid if all participants consent.
required_dossiers: Notice convening the first board meeting
Register of members and register of directors
Consents to act signed by each director and officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any omission in the minutes may be corrected by a rectification resolution passed at the next meeting; late filing of consents with the registered agent is cured by submission of a signed copy within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Registered Office and Agent Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Company's registered office in Apia, Samoa, is confirmed in Form IC-RO, together with the consent of the licensed registered agent. The Registrar endorses the registered office entry and issues an extract of the register reflecting the Company's officers and office address for banking and licensing purposes.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A change of registered office is effected by filing Form IC-ROC within 14 days; late filing attracts a prescribed penalty of approximately WST 50 and is cured upon payment and lodgment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) - Labour and Occupational Safety and Health Division, Apia, Samoa
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Workplace Registration Certificate under Part IX of the Labour and Employment Act 2013 - not mandatory for pure offshore formation but required before commissioning any physical plush-toy production facility in Samoa.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) - Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 - Controlled Activity (Development Consent with Environmental Management Plan); a full EIA Report is not required for low-impact plush toy assembly using computerised embroidery and ultrasonic seaming.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Trade wastewater must comply with the Water Resources Management Act 2008 permit conditions or discharge to municipal sewer; VOC and adhesive emissions from fabric assembly must remain below workplace exposure limits adopted from WHO/ILO guidelines; textile off-cuts, foam dust, and packaging waste require licensed municipal carrier disposal; ozone-depleting substances are prohibited in foam fill and packaging under Samoa's Ozone Layer Protection Regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) confirming means of escape, fire extinguisher coverage, and alarm systems; structural load inspection certificate from the MNRE Building Division verifying floor capacity for embroidery machinery; occupational health clearance covering machine guarding for ultrasonic seamers, needle protection on embroidery units, dust extraction, and first-aid facilities under Part IX of the Labour and Employment Act 2013.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MINR), Government of Samoa; official taxpayer portal: MINR e-Services (http://www.minr.gov.ws)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-owned International Companies (ICs) must obtain a Tax Identification Number (TIN) from MINR and, if VAGST-registrable, a separate VAGST registration number. Procedure: (1) File the certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation issued under the International Companies Act 1987, the constitutional documents, and the registered agent appointment letter; (2) Submit the TIN application form with director and shareholder particulars, registered office address in Samoa (via the licensed registered agent), and a statement confirming non-resident status; (3) MINR verifies the application against the Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA) registry and issues the TIN within 5 to 10 business days; (4) If annual taxable turnover reaches or is likely to exceed WST 100,000, file mandatory VAGST registration under the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2012 within 21 days; (5) Obtain a Customs client code with the Samoa Customs Service (administered by MINR) for lodging export declarations for the plush mascot goods.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box style entity classification election exists in Samoan law. IC status is elective at incorporation under the International Companies Act 1987; electing and maintaining IC status statutorily exempts the entity from Samoa income tax, VAGST, and stamp duty on offshore business activities. Hybrid mismatch elections under OECD BEPS Action 2 have not been domesticated, and no statutory hybrid or deemed-dividend elections are available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 annual taxable turnover (compulsory); voluntary registration is available but uncommon for ICs whose offshore turnover is statutorily exempt
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API-based e-invoicing, or digital stamping mandate is in force in Samoa. Taxpayers may issue paper or standard electronic invoices; VAGST returns and payments are filed electronically through the MINR e-Services portal. Export transactions must be supported by standard customs declarations through the Samoa Customs Service (ASYCUDA World), but no fiscal device certification or digital stamping of invoices is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under section 12 of the VAGST Act 2012 to: (a) goods physically exported by the supplier from Samoa within the prescribed period (generally 28 days from the date of supply) and retained outside Samoa; (b) services performed outside Samoa or wholly consumed outside Samoa; and (c) supplies to non-resident operators of vessels or aircraft engaged in international transport. A plush toy OEM exporting finished mascots to overseas wholesale buyers qualifies for the 0% rate on export supply provided the supplier retains documentary proof of physical export, transfer of ownership, and receipt of consideration from the non-resident buyer.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SED/EDN) lodged via Samoa Customs Service ASYCUDA World
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (dated, endorsed, and consigned to the overseas buyer)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing foreign currency proceeds
Purchase order, sales contract, and INCOTERMS delivery terms supporting export title transfer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: MINR conducts desk and field audits of zero-rated export claims, cross-matching customs export data, shipping documents, and FX inflow records. Where zero-rating is claimed without actual physical export or with false or forged documentation, MINR issues a default assessment of VAGST at 15% on the supply value, plus a late payment penalty of 10% of the unpaid tax and statutory interest accruing under the VAGST Act 2012; intentional or reckless conduct attracts an additional 50% shortfall penalty. Criminal prosecution may result in fines up to WST 50,000 and imprisonment. For ICs, fraudulent use of the exemption regime can trigger revocation of the International Company certificate and reclassification as a domestic company by SIFSA, with retrospective income tax and VAGST exposure.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), Exchange Control Division, Apia; governing statutes are the Exchange Control Act 1975 and the Exchange Control Regulations 1976, supplemented by the Foreign Investment Act 2000 (administered by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour) and the Samoa International Financial Authority Act 2017.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is not freely convertible offshore; the CBS manages the exchange rate against a trade-weighted basket of major partner currencies. Current-account payments for goods and services are processed through authorized dealers upon submission of supporting trade documents, while capital-account transactions require CBS approval unless a statutory exemption applies. A qualifying International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 is exempt from Exchange Control approval for foreign-currency transactions with non-residents and is prohibited from domestic WST-denominated operations; profit and dividend remittances to non-resident shareholders are exempt from Samoan withholding tax provided the IC does not carry on business with Samoan residents and all banking is executed in foreign currency.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For goods physically exported from Samoa, the exporter must file an export declaration with an authorized dealer before shipment, repatriate full proceeds to a licensed Samoan bank within 3 months from the date of export, and offer the foreign currency for conversion to WST; the CBS may order mandatory conversion of up to 100% of proceeds only in exceptional reserve emergencies. An IC in the offshore plush-toy OEM model (goods procured in China and shipped directly to overseas buyers, never entering Samoan customs territory) falls outside the territorial surrender obligation, but the licensed Samoan bank will still route all receipts through foreign-currency accounts and apply CBS reporting codes to prevent misclassification as a domestic export.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (Samoa) Limited (BSP) – formerly Westpac Bank Samoa Limited, Apia
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Multi-Currency Account (USD/EUR) and Foreign-Currency Trade Settlement Account; separate Capital Escrow Account available for share-capital injection
USD Foreign-Currency Operating Account for non-resident ICs and dedicated Capital Escrow Sub-account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: National Bank of Samoa Limited (NBS), Apia
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Multi-Currency Account; subject to prior CBS exchange-control approval where domestic WST conversion or domestic business activity is involved

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium viability. Samoa has no dedicated EMI or digital-bank licensing class; the CBS licenses banks and non-bank financial institutions under the Financial Institutions Act 1996 and does not recognize electronic money issuance as a standalone licensed activity. Major global EMIs (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer) generally do not onboard Samoa-registered International Companies due to correspondent-bank de-risking and lack any Samoa clearing membership; they may be used only as a secondary inbound collection conduit where the EMI accepts Samoan corporate clients and settles onward via SWIFT to the IC's USD account at a CBS-licensed bank. Legal constraint: no EMI may clear WST-denominated payments or hold Samoan client deposits without a CBS license.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is de facto mandatory: at least one natural-person signatory (director or ultimate beneficial owner) must attend a branch interview in Apia to execute the account mandate and verify signatures; remote video KYC may supplement but not fully substitute for the face-to-face interview because Samoa's AML/CFT framework (Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 and CBS AML/CFT Guidelines) and correspondent-bank on-boarding rules impose enhanced identification for non-resident companies. A licensed registered agent approved by the Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) can pre-clear the file and act as introducer; corporate documents must be notarized and legalized or apostilled (where the issuing jurisdiction is a Hague Apostille Convention party) with certified English translations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore tax-exempt International Company stigma and perceived lack of economic substance in Samoa.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation; Certificate of Good Standing; Memorandum and Articles of Association; registered-agent confirmation; SIFA IC registration extract; tax-exemption confirmation from the Ministry of Revenue; board resolution approving banking mandate; group structure chart; detailed OEM business plan for plush-toy sourcing and export; executed supplier and buyer contracts; written legal opinion confirming the IC's exchange-control exemption and non-resident status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial ownership, nominee-director structures, or legacy bearer-share concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified current register of directors and members (full names, dates of birth, nationalities, residential addresses); beneficial-ownership declaration identifying all natural persons controlling 10% or more; certified passport copies of all shareholders and directors; sworn source-of-funds and source-of-wealth statements; professional reference letter from the licensed SIFA registered agent; bank reference letters from any prior banking relationships.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction-profile mismatch: expected export-sales funds from plush-toy OEM trade versus absence of employees or physical manufacturing facility.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed OEM manufacturing agreements with the offshore (e.g., China/Vietnam) factory; full purchase orders and pro-forma invoices matched to the funding amount; bills of lading and/or airway bills from recent shipments; third-party factory audit or inspection reports; logistics and quality-control provider contracts; cost breakdown of raw materials, freight, insurance, and duties supporting invoice values.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Correspondent-bank de-risking triggered by cross-border payments to or from higher-risk trade corridors or opaque settlement flows.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Final beneficiary and originator confirmation for all counterparties; sanctions and PEP screening results for the IC and its counterparties; completed correspondent-bank compliance questionnaire; full set of underlying commercial contracts and shipping documents; written undertaking to provide transaction-level documentation within 48 hours upon request; commitment to route all platform payouts solely to the IC's licensed Samoan USD corporate account.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route equity capital via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's account (typically Hong Kong or Singapore) to the IC's USD foreign-currency account at the licensed Samoan bank; the remittance must carry the exchange-control purpose code for inward investment/capital injection and a structurally clear memo referencing the IC registration number and 'working capital for OEM trade'. A Foreign Investment Certificate under the Foreign Investment Act 2000 is not required because the IC conducts no business with Samoan residents, but the bank will require a board resolution and share-allotment evidence, and for amounts above approximately USD 100,000 it will also require a legal opinion and beneficial-ownership declaration; the licensed bank completes CBS exchange-control reporting on behalf of the IC.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settle trade payables to overseas plush-toy manufacturers via SWIFT MT103 priority telegraphic transfer using the trade purpose code 'Payment for Imported Goods', or via a sight Commercial Letter of Credit issued by the Samoan bank through SWIFT MT700 and confirmed by a first-class Asian confirming bank to mitigate exporter risk. Open-account settlements through Platform_Pay rails are acceptable only where the platform remits directly to the IC's BSP or SCB USD corporate account and the payment is supported by matching invoices and shipment documentation; Samoa has no domestic cross-border clearing system, so all settlements settle through the banks' USD correspondent networks in the United States or the Asia-Pacific region.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot foreign-exchange contracts (delivery within T+2) with the licensed authorized dealer for converting any incidental WST balances into USD or other required trade currencies.

Deliverable forward FX contracts with a licensed Samoan commercial bank for maturities up to 12 months, permitted only where the underlying import/export exposure is evidenced by contracts and invoices.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in WST executed by the IC directly with a non-resident bank and settled in USD outside Samoa; no domestic NDF market exists, but offshore execution is legally permissible and does not require CBS approval under the IC exchange-control exemption.

Bilateral cross-currency swaps between the IC and a non-resident counterparty for hedging USD/WST or USD/AUD exposures, documented and booked outside Samoa, with CBS notification to the licensed Samoan bank where settlement cash flows transit the Samoan account.
Natural hedging strategy (recommended primary practice): denominate both supplier payments and customer receipts in USD to eliminate WST conversion risk entirely in the plush-toy OEM trade cycle.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual Government License Fee Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Registrar of International Companies (Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 June for every International Company; pro-rated for companies incorporated after 1 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs a penalty assessment not exceeding USD 200; non-renewal beyond 90 days triggers a dissolution notice, and failure to remedy within 6 months results in administrative strike-off and 3-year liability for debts contracted during default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Registrar of International Companies through the Licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed concurrently with the Annual Return, no later than 30 June each year; updates required within 14 days after any transfer of shares changing ultimate beneficial ownership.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-maintenance or late filing of beneficial ownership records is an offence under the AML/CFT regime, carrying fines of up to USD 10,000 and potential 12-month custodial sanction for directors.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Retention Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Declared at annual license renewal on or before 30 June, or within 14 days of any change in the licensed registered agent or physical registered office address.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered agent and office in Samoa is a continuing offence punishable by a fine of USD 100 per day; the Registrar may strike off the company after two months' notice.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Not required by default for International Companies; mandatory only for International Companies holding a banking, insurance, or fiduciary service license under the Samoa International Companies Act and AML/CFT legislation, or upon a valid shareholder request exercising the 10% threshold.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as endorsed in Samoa; International Companies without a filing or audit obligation are permitted to maintain internal accounting records under IFRS with no requirement for statutory financial statement publication.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent must identify and verify all individuals exercising ultimate control over the International Company, record their details in the beneficial ownership register, and submit a confirmation declaration with the annual return. Any transfer of shares that changes beneficial ownership must be logged and notified to the Registrar within 14 days of the resolution; the register must be updated at least annually.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – USD 6,000 per engagement, if audit becomes mandatory or is shareholder-requested

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for Samoa International Companies (IC); 27% for Samoa resident companies under the Income Tax Act 2012
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Permanent full exemption from Samoan income tax, capital gains tax, and stamp duty for International Companies; only an annual registry license/annual fee is payable, materially producing a zero effective tax rate on qualifying offshore trade, including OEM manufacturing of plush mascot stuffed animals for non-resident principals.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return – Form 6 (Samoa International Companies Registry, filed by a licenced registered agent via the Samoa International Companies Registry e-portal; no corporate income tax return is required for an exempt International Company under the International Companies Act 1987)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual – one filing per calendar year, due within 60 days after the anniversary of incorporation, or, if a fiscal year is adopted, within 60 days after the fiscal year-end
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return and annual fee are statutorily due no later than 60 days after the anniversary date of incorporation; no extension beyond six months is ordinarily granted and a longer delay may trigger administrative strike-off

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, International Company registration number, date of incorporation, and current status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners should ensure the registered agent accurately discloses the exact corporate name, not a trading style, and confirms the IC number to avoid registry mismatches.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part B – Registered Agent and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of the licensed international company registered agent in Samoa and the physical registered office address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the non-resident shareholder changes the registered agent, a new Agent Agreement and Form for Change of Registered Agent must be filed simultaneously.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationality, residential addresses, and ID document numbers of all current directors; minimum one director and one shareholder required.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be natural persons or corporate entities of any nationality; no Samoan-residency requirement applies to an IC, but the registered agent must hold a current director identification record for AML purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, shareholdings, and classes of shares; bearer shares are not permitted for Samoan International Companies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Where a non-resident holds more than 25%, the ultimate beneficial owner must be identified in the AML file; do not enter nominee-only details if the beneficial owner is known.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part E – Authorised and Issued Share Capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Currency, authorised capital, issued shares, and total annual fee calculation base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Annual registry fee may be tiered by share capital; minimise authorised capital to the documented business requirement for the plush OEM venture.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Brief description of the IC's commercial activity, e.g. contract manufacturing, procurement, and marketing of plush mascot stuffed animals for a non-resident group.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe the offshore activity without stating any domestic Samoan trade; confirm the IC does not derive income from sources within Samoa.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of the chosen accounting reference date, normally 31 December or a date coinciding with the parent group's reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use 31 December for consistency with the tax-exempt declaration; any change requires notice to the Registry.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part H – Declaration of Exempt Status
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business with Samoan residents and has not owned or acquired restricted real property in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure no Samoan-source revenue is recorded; a false declaration is a criminal offence and may nullify the IC's tax exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payment of the prescribed government annual fee to the Samoa International Companies Registry.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident beneficial owner must remit funds to the registered agent before the due date, in cleared WST or an approved foreign currency, to avoid late penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature and certification of the registered agent that the information is true and complete under the International Companies Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent remains accountable for the filing; provide the agent with notarised copies of updated director and shareholder records.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return and full payment of the annual fee attracts a late fee calculated on a daily or monthly basis (commonly WST 100 per month or fraction, up to an aggregate equal to the principal annual fee) and may lead to enforced deregistration/strike-off of the International Company; directors may be personally prohibited from managing any Samoan international company for up to three years, and reinstatement is possible only through the Registrar's discretionary restoration procedure with prescribed reinstatement fees.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Income Tax Return for a Samoa Tax-Exempt International Company (N/A – Administrative Landing Page)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annually – only in respect of any non-exempt derived income, which should not exist for a compliant IC
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Not applicable unless income taxable under Samoa's Income Tax Act 2012 is unexpectedly derived; a domestic corporate taxpayer must file within six months after the end of the accounting period

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Samoa International Companies are statutorily exempt from all income tax; therefore no Ministry of Revenue tax return is required solely by reason of IC status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners should nonetheless preserve the valid IC registration and annual fee receipts to evidence the exemption in any parent-group tax or audit file.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No penalty arises for not filing an income tax return where the IC has no taxable income; however, if the IC is found to have transacted with Samoan residents or derived uncontrolled domestic income, the exempt status can be revoked retroactively, triggering corporate income tax at 27%, interest on unpaid tax, and a late-filing penalty of up to 20% of the assessed tax.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends paid by a Samoa International Company to non-resident shareholders, including distributions of previously exempt trading profits; domestic non-international companies may face Samoan final dividend withholding tax at the applicable rate (31 December 2017 regime), but an IC is contractually and statutorily excluded from that regime.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke treaty relief on any residual Samoan-source payment, a non-resident shareholder or creditor must obtain a Certificate of Residence (COR/TRC) from the tax authority of its residence jurisdiction, complete the relevant Samoa treaty relief form, and submit all documentation to Samoa's Ministry of Revenue through a licensed tax agent; the IC's registered agent should also prepare a letter certifying the IC's tax-exempt status and non-resident payment flow. The protocol requires application before the payment or within the time allowed for claiming a foreign tax credit under the treaty.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Samoan non-resident withholding tax is typically 20% on interest and 20% on royalties derived from Samoa; however, an International Company enjoys an absolute exemption from Samoan income tax and does not generate Samoan-source interest or royalty income merely because a non-resident parent grants a license to the IC. For any remote Samoan-source royalty or interest payment, available tax treaty rates may reduce the withholding rate to 0% (e.g., under an applicable comprehensive DTA with a relevant jurisdictions such as Australia, New Zealand, or Hong Kong where the DTA is in effect), subject to non-resident residence certification and full beneficial ownership disclosure.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Samoa has no detailed local-file/master-file threshold enacted for domestic taxpayers; the Income Tax Act 2012 applies a general arm's length rule to cross-border related-party transactions. For an exempt International Company, no mandatory transfer pricing documentation is statutorily required, but prudent risk-based policy requires a Country-by-Country Report threshold benchmark of WST 550 million consolidated group revenue when the ultimate parent group is obliged under the OECD Multilateral Instrument or Samoa's CbC rules; in all events, the IC should retain a one-page TP policy, cost contribution summary, and margin analysis in WST below a notional WST 10 million transaction threshold.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa's International Companies framework applies economic substance principles derived from the International Companies Act 1987, latest amendments, and Samoa's international tax standards: an IC must have a registered agent and registered office in Samoa, maintain books and records reflecting transactions, and cannot carry on business with Samoan residents. For a plush mascot OEM, the IC must demonstrate commercial substance in the buyer-supply chain through genuine contracts, purchase orders, and correspondence evidencing that it performs design, procurement, and logistics functions; no separate Samoan 'Economic Substance Regulations' akin to UAE ESR apply, but the Samoa Tax Administration will respect the IC's exemption only if the IC is not a shell and does not produce Samoan-source income.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: False declarations in the annual return that no Samoan-source economic activity occurred, while the IC in fact sells goods to Samoan residents, uses Samoan office space as a management base, or operates a Samoan warehouse for the plush OEM business without a valid domestic tax registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of tax-exempt status retroactively, assessment of corporate income tax at 27% on all relevant profits, understatement penalties up to 100% of the tax due, refusal of treaty benefits, and criminal liability under the Tax Administration Act 2012 including fines up to WST 300,000 and imprisonment up to seven years for tax evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be made personally liable for tax collected but not remitted, ordered to pay civil restitution equal to the unpaid tax and penalties, barred by court order from leaving Samoa pending criminal tax proceedings, and during a criminal conviction subjected to imprisonment of up to seven years in addition to disgorgement of hidden profits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Misuse / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the Samoa IC solely as a letterbox company with no registered agent instruction, no board authority, no accounting records, and no commercial activity while international banks or the parent group use it to channel invoices and payments for plush toy manufacturing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Compulsory strike-off after failure to file annual returns, negative shareholder and director disqualification, refusal of tax residence/benefit documentation by Samoa's Ministry of Revenue, and potential reclassification of profits under the general anti-avoidance rule, resulting in a 27% corporate tax assessment plus interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be disqualified from holding office in any Samoa company for up to five years, ordered to reimburse the company for any loss caused by failure to maintain records, issued travel bans where a criminal investigation commences, and sentenced to imprisonment for up to one year for delictual filing without substance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC to receive SEPA, Swift TT or Platform_Pay proceeds without identifying the ultimate beneficial owner, deliberately omitting a politically exposed person from the AML file, or transacting with a sanctioned entity while operating the stuffed animal OEM.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalty up to WST 500,000 for a corporate body, freezing of bank accounts under the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2007, seizure of the plush OEM manufacturing assets, and criminal sanction of up to fourteen years' imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and other senior officers are personally liable for knowingly causing the IC to breach AML/CFT obligations; the court may order civil forfeiture of the profit share, an international travel ban to prevent abscondment, and a term of imprisonment of up to fourteen years, with no right to rely on corporate limited liability.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Improper Profit Repatriation / Withholding Tax Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring a large dividend distribution through the IC while concealing the Samoan residence of the beneficial recipient, misusing a nominee shareholder to avoid the Samoa resident dividend withholding tax, or incorrectly classifying an actual royalty payment as a dividend to avoid the cross-border royalty withholding tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of unrepaid withholding tax at the full statutory rate of 20% on the redirected payment, add-on penalty of 10% per month up to 100% of the tax, interest at commercial rate, and potential criminal fine of up to WST 240,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorise the false classification of a payment are jointly and severally liable for the withholding shortfall when Samoa tax recovery is impossible from the corporate funds, may be barred from emigration pending an exit-permit receipt or court order, and may be charged with fraudulent return preparation punishable by up to seven years' imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Improper Use of Samoa IC as a Domestic Trading Entity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the International Company to operate a physical plush doll manufacturing facility located within Samoa, hire Samoan domestic employees, lease Samoa property, or sell directly to Samoan retail customers without first registering as a domestic company under the Companies Act 2001 and the Income Tax Act 2012.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of the IC's tax exempt status; the Samoa Ministry of Revenue will assess corporate tax at the 27% headline rate on all local-source income; a separate business license fee becomes due; and the Registrar of International Companies may issue a compliance order and impose a monetary penalty not exceeding WST 100,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who knowingly permits the IC to carry on domestic business may be personally assessed for the resulting tax, held liable for all employment taxes and social security contributions, subjected to a court injunction against further local operations, and in egregious cases sentenced to up to five years' imprisonment for conducting unlicensed commercial activity through an exempt vehicle.
